ABOUT

# Transforming how enterprises measure efficiency

Mimica helps the world’s largest enterprises meet ambitious transformation goals through unprecedented workflow visibility. Our AI automatically translates the clicks and keystrokes that make up a team’s work into comprehensive process maps, delivering an actionable roadmap for process improvement and automation.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/682e2533cf00d7699fde7482/6845e1f57fe53dfc9ac7f488_Group%20101161.svg)![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/682e2533cf00d7699fde7482/6845e1f534000d99811c2e67_Group%20101162.svg)![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/682e2533cf00d7699fde7482/6845e1f5fad890c065a2f8d4_Group%20101163.svg)

OUR MISSION

Empower enterprises, teams, and individuals to reclaim their most precious resource — time

Our vision is a world where business processes run seamlessly. We’re making it a reality, having saved enterprises over 1 million hours of productivity – and counting.

## Our journey

2018

Mimica is founded on the idea of handing monotonous tasks over to AI, freeing people to focus on their most engaging, valuable work.

2019

Raised first round of seed financing through Episode 1 Ventures

2020

Launched Mapper, which processes click and keystroke data into accurate process maps

2021

Raised Series A funding from Khosla Ventures; 100% of pilots convert to paid customers

2022

Launched Miner, AI-powered task mining that delivers intelligence on ROI, automatability, and ease of automation

2023

Named Leader & Star Performer in Task Mining by Everest Group

2024

Named Leader & Star Performer in Digital Interaction Intelligence (DII) by Everest Group

2025

Raised Series B funding from Paladin Capital Group
